scripts.db:migrate:d1: pnpm --filter @magomap/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env d1
scripts.deploy:d1: pnpm --filter @magomap/web build && pnpm --filter @magomap/api exec wrangler deploy --env d1
scripts.deploy:postgres: pnpm --filter @magomap/web build && pnpm --filter @magomap/api exec wrangler deploy --env postgres
